reasoning_content:
No browsers installed. Playwright tests can't run without browser download. But that's a test infra, not the install guide requirement.

Let me verify the example app more thoroughly - check that the server serves the actual app HTML with the root div and that library loads. Also try to render in a headless way. Without a browser, we can at least confirm HTTP 200 and the transformed modules.

Actually, let me try to run the built example dist via `vite preview` or check. But more valuable: verify the library import in a DOM-less environment is not feasible.

Let me confirm the whole thing works at HTTP level and maybe check for runtime errors. Without a browser we can't detect runtime JS errors. But we could try to install... no, we cannot install.

Let me consider: is the guide reproduced? Guide says `npm install @seitenbau-dev/formulardesigner` - published package. And example app `npm run start:example` reachable at localhost:5173. The example app is running and serving 200. That's evidence.

Let me do a deeper check: try to evaluate the bundle with jsdom? Not installed. Could use node with a minimal DOM? Not feasible.

Let me at least verify there are no build/serve errors and the served HTML references. Also check Vite can transform the library and modules without errors - fetch a few module transforms and look for error responses.

Let me fetch several example modules to look for transform errors (500 status or error messages).

action.command: cd /workspace && for u in /src/main.tsx /src/App.tsx /src/example-forms.ts /src/modules/text.tsx /src/modules/date.tsx /src/index.css "/@fs/workspace/dist/assets/index.css"; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:5173$u"); err=$(grep -o -m1 "Internal server error\|Pre-transform error\|Failed to resolve" /tmp/o); echo "$code  $u  ${err:+ERR:$err}"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && for u in /src/main.tsx /src/App.tsx /src/example-forms.ts /src/modules/text.tsx /src/modules/date.tsx /src/index.css \"/@fs/workspace/dist/assets/index.css\"; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w \"%{http_code}\" \"http://localhost:5173$u\"); err=$(grep -o -m1 \"Internal server error\\|Pre-transform error\\|Failed to resolve\" /tmp/o); echo \"$code  $u  ${err:+ERR:$err}\"; done", "summary": "Check module transforms for errors", "security_risk": "LOW"}
